independent_translation.speaker: Merchant
independent_translation.translation: I say that I am useful both to the king and to nobles, and to wealthy people, and to all the people.

independent_translation.speaker: Merchant
independent_translation.translation: I board my ship with my cargo, and row across stretches of sea, and sell my goods, and buy valuable things which are not produced in this land; and I bring the goods here to you at great risk across the sea, and sometimes I suffer shipwreck, with the loss of all my things, barely escaping alive.
